column2: ...Ever since he started associating with you, $$セラフィム$$ has become stranger and stranger!
Talking about freeing white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s, and how everyone ought to have $$平等$$!
And then, on top of that, he called you...
a $$奴隷$$ with no value in knowing, his best friend!!
$$友情$$ is nothing more than a borrowing and lending of feelings!
People only associate with each other because there is something in it for them...
What meaning could such a thing possibly have?!
My...
My relationship with $$セラフィム$$ is not like that!!
Then what is $$友情$$?! Say it plainly!!
Movie: “$$マルコ$$ Shields $$グザファン$$”
What is this? Doing that now...
Hah! Are you trying to make me like you this time?!
No!!
My body just... moved on its own!
That kind of act is pointless.
I will not be fooled like $$セラフィム$$ was!!
That is not true, $$グザファン$$!
O-old man $$ケルビム$$!!
$$ルピルピ$$, are you safe?
Yes, somehow.
$$グザファン$$!! You have not changed at all since you were little...
What lies hidden beneath your hatred...
is envy of the $$友情$$ between $$マルコ$$ and $$セラフィム$$!
Tch!
Yes. You were the same even then.
